summary: Feature 'Delete buttons on tornei/stanze/leghe' tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed on DELETE endpoints for Survival, ScoreAndLive, TheBestTiket, FantaGiornata (create → delete → 404-verify + player-401/403 permission check). Frontend: verified as admin the sv-delete-{id} button on /survival deletes the card, does NOT navigate (stopPropagation OK), removes from list and from API. Verified regression: click on card body still navigates to /survival/{id}. Verified as player e1_qa_player that NO delete buttons (sv/sal/tk/fg-delete-*) appear on /survival, /scoreandlive, /tiket, /fanta.
critical_code_review_comments: Survival DELETE /sv/tournaments/{tid} uses require_admin dependency (global admin only). This is fine per spec but note that non-global-admin tournament creators cannot delete their own tornei — differs from FantaGiornata delete which uses _require_league_admin (allows league admin OR global admin).
SAL delete has nice safety guard: force=true required if picks exist (returns 409). Frontend must handle this two-step confirm (per user spec).
seed_data_creation: All test data uses ZZ_DELETE_TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up (deleted) as part of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test file test_delete_buttons.py covers all 4 delete endpoints. Reusable for future iterations. All tests create ZZ_DELETE_TEST_ prefixed entities so they never touch real production data.
